amends_without_overwriting.reason: Prospectively harden the estimands, missingness rules and small-sample inference before the corrected R3 outcome matrix is read. In particular, replace v1's target-exit-adjusted primary efficiency estimand with ego route-completion duration, whose measurement definition is not conditioned on another treatment-responsive actor.

treatment_design: complete paired 2 predictor-stack x 4 risk-policy x 2 target-style block within every init

outcome_clock_and_geometry.clock: CARLA simulation seconds; timestamps are absolute within a rollout and durations are relative to rollout start
outcome_clock_and_geometry.rollout_start_timestamp_s: minimum sim_time_start_s in risk_by_conflict_distance_summary.csv for the rollout
outcome_clock_and_geometry.ego_route_completion_duration_s: smpc_completion.json step divided by scenario_run_summary.json carla_fps, only when completion_valid is true; this completion event clock includes the run_step that sets goal_reached and is the primary efficiency estimand
outcome_clock_and_geometry.df_logged_trajectory_duration_s: df_full.csv completion_time (last minus first logged trajectory timestamp), retained only as a consistency check because the completion state can be deliberately omitted after goal_reached
outcome_clock_and_geometry.target_fixed_zone_exit_timestamp_s: target_exit_time_s from the single fixed_geometry_yield_rules record, using controller route projection and the frozen 4.0 m radius
outcome_clock_and_geometry.post_clearance_completion_lag_s: ego_completion_timestamp_s - target_fixed_zone_exit_timestamp_s; this is the canonical executable name for the original fixed_geometry_adjusted_delay_s and is secondary in v2
outcome_clock_and_geometry.fixed_geometry_yield_gap_s: ego_enter_time_s - target_exit_time_s; positive values mean the target exited before ego entry, before applying the separately frozen 0.2 s binary tolerance
outcome_clock_and_geometry.minimum_footprint_separation_m: minimum oriented-rectangle separation from pair_safety using the frozen 0.25 m per-actor inflation; actual actor blueprint, bounding-box dimensions, local pose offsets and geometry source are emitted per rollout
outcome_clock_and_geometry.causal_interpretation_warning: post_clearance_completion_lag_s is a relational timing decomposition, not covariate adjustment: target exit can itself respond to treatment. It is therefore secondary and cannot establish efficiency; ego route-completion duration is the primary efficiency outcome.

secondary_and_mechanism_outcomes: in-loop top1 ADE/FDE and calibrated trajectory NLL

binary_failure_taxonomy.native_collision_any: one if the hardened audit records at least one canonical contact episode after validating CARLA callbacks and merging mirrored sensors by unordered actor pair; callback counts are reported separately
binary_failure_taxonomy.native_collision_episode_count: descriptive canonical actor-pair contact episodes after collapsing frame-contiguous callbacks and mirrored sensor reports; never used as an independent sample size
binary_failure_taxonomy.footprint_collision: one if the frozen oriented-rectangle replay reports overlap at any sampled step
binary_failure_taxonomy.fixed_geometry_yield_failure: one only when target_clears_before_ego_enters is observed false; missing entry/exit produces unknown, not an imputed failure or success
binary_failure_taxonomy.completion_failure: one when completion_valid is observed false; a missing completion flag is unknown
binary_failure_taxonomy.failure_comparison: intent-to-treat rollout-binary treatment-minus-control difference paired by init; callback counts and simulator steps are never treated as Bernoulli trials

missingness_and_censoring.continuous_rule: A primary continuous effect is complete only when both paired treatment values are finite. Missing pairs are excluded only from that metric/contrast and their init IDs and reasons are emitted.
missingness_and_censoring.completion_censoring: Observed completion_valid=false makes ego completion and post-clearance lag scientifically undefined/censored even if a logged-trajectory duration is present. Missing/corrupt completion telemetry is an integrity defect.
missingness_and_censoring.zone_censoring: Missing target exit makes target-exit elapsed time and post-clearance lag undefined; missing either target exit or ego entry makes yield gap undefined.
missingness_and_censoring.binary_rule: Observed adverse binary outcomes remain in all analyses. Unknown binary outcomes are never set to zero; they make the corresponding no-excess guard unresolved.
missingness_and_censoring.universal_claim_rule: Any missing cell, scientifically censored primary pair or unresolved binary guard prevents universal support. Prespecified censoring caused by an observed failure is a valid not-supported scientific result; missing/corrupt telemetry is an integrity defect.

H3.scope: nominal target timing only (target_offset_m = 0); timing-shift/legacy matrices are not pooled
H3.contrast: B1 minus B0 within each risk-policy x target-style x init block
H3.support_rule: Universal directional support requires mean B1-minus-B0 ego route-completion duration <= the time tolerance, mean B1-minus-B0 separation >= minus the distance tolerance in every one of eight cells, and no excess observed binary failure in any cell. Missingness or unresolved binary outcomes yields insufficient evidence.
H3.claim_language: nominal-condition directional consistency only; exact n=5 tests cannot attain two-sided p<0.05 and must not be described as confirmatory significance

H4.contrast: adaptive minus each of fixed_aggressive, fixed_medium and fixed_conservative within predictor x target-style x init
H4.families: Within each predictor-style stratum and primary outcome, the three fixed-comparator p-values form one Holm family (eight families total).
H4.dominance_rule: Adaptive dominates a comparator when mean ego route-completion duration is no greater within time tolerance, mean separation is no smaller within distance tolerance, at least one is strictly better beyond tolerance, all five pairs are complete for both outcomes, and all no-excess binary guards are observed and satisfied.
H4.universal_support_rule: H4 requires dominance over all three fixed comparators in all four predictor-style strata; otherwise the universal claim is not supported.

inference.raw_effects: emit every init-level paired effect, including zeros, plus arithmetic mean and median
inference.exact_test: two-sided exhaustive sign-flip test over complete init-cluster effects, including all 2^n assignments and ties at or beyond the observed absolute mean
inference.holm_method: step-down adjusted p=max over ordered ranks of (m-rank+1)*raw_p, clipped to one; missing p-values remain missing and prevent universal support

bootstrap.method: percentile cluster bootstrap of the arithmetic mean, resampling complete init effects with replacement
bootstrap.contrast_seed_derivation: first 16 hexadecimal characters of SHA256(global_seed|contrast_id|metric), interpreted as an integer

inference.equivalence_rule: p greater than 0.05 and a confidence interval crossing zero are not evidence of equivalence

numerical_tolerances.interpretation: These handle the 0.05 s simulator sampling interval and floating-point storage only; they are not SESOI, equivalence or non-inferiority margins.

footprint_margin_sensitivity.rule: Emit every rollout at every frozen margin (320 rows) and recompute all 12 H4 adaptive-versus-fixed dominance decisions at each margin (48 rows). Ego completion is unchanged; separation, footprint collision and the no-excess guard use the selected margin. This is prespecified sensitivity, not a search for a favourable margin.

manipulation_checks.predictor: Recompute full-horizon in-loop top1 ADE, top1 FDE, minADE and calibrated trajectory NLL from prediction_dataset_labeled.jsonl. Report rollout-macro B1-minus-B0 contrasts matched by risk, style and init; divergent closed-loop windows make these descriptive checks, not a new causal prediction benchmark.
manipulation_checks.risk: Report step-weighted risk_tightening_mean and solver_uses_adaptive_risk_frac for every rollout/cell. Fixed arms should show zero adaptive-solver use; adaptive arms should show non-zero adaptive-solver use and risk variation. A failed manipulation check is a scientific limitation, not an analysis-pipeline error.

completion_semantics.analysis_status: Top-level analyzer status reports only schema, provenance, coverage and computation completeness.
completion_semantics.scientific_status: Negative, null, adverse or non-dominant results are valid outputs and never make analysis status fail.
completion_semantics.study_stop_rule: Stop formal large-scale collection after 80/80 integrity-valid rollouts when every outcome is either observed or undefined for a prespecified scientific censoring reason and every table is computed. Finite primary outcomes are not required: observed completion/yield failure may legitimately censor timing and itself blocks universal support.

prohibitions: Do not overwrite the original M0 contract.
Do not pool legacy, pilot, timing-shift or corrected nominal R3 rollouts.
Do not treat simulator steps, prediction windows or collision callbacks as independent experimental units.
Do not silently impute, drop or relabel missing/censored outcomes.
Do not call zero observed collision proof of safety.
Do not interpret B1 versus B0 solely as model-weight attribution because their calibration stacks differ.
Do not interpret Holm-adjusted non-significance as equivalence.
Do not tune tolerances, families, bootstrap settings or support rules after reading R3 outcomes.
